## Principal decisions

**Endurance now has an explicit NEW EX58 bridge.** It does not create a second calendar or silently double irregular Rest Debt deadlines. Two separate cause-specific counters omit every first qualifying food/water-only daily penalty and sleep-debt penalty, and apply every second. Actual shortage assessments, Rest Debt opening and deadlines, safe eight-hour rest, unsupported-day restrictions and the two-work-Watch ceiling remain intact. The exact wording expressly identifies this as a **half-frequency penalty-event interpretation**, not recovered source wording promising doubled elapsed deadlines.

**Distinct eligible flat feat bonuses add; hostile slows remain strongest-only.** Existing class, spell, item, cover, Expertise, advantage, resistance and critical-range rules retain their own scope. Slasher and Crippling Strike do not produce two additive −10 Speed penalties. Anatomy Lore and Nightfang have explicit native-damage percentage calculations before saving-throw reduction and defenses, without percentage-on-percentage compounding.

**Locks and caltrops keep their actual equipment procedures.** Burglar preserves the ordinary lock’s **Action/DC 15** rather than introducing a one-minute baseline. Trapsetter’s caltrop field remains hazardous after its first trigger. Actual pieces, coverage, collection, disarming and custody remain physical; a replacement trap cannot remotely erase an earlier one.

**The affected “allies” clauses include the owner when their actual predicates permit it.** This does not remove genuine “other” wording or inherently two-person geometry. Self-targeted movement still requires the owner’s available Reaction. Slayer’s Resolve now explicitly covers **ranged attack-roll Dragon breath weapons**, while ordinary non-breath ranged attacks remain outside that Reaction branch. Its personal breath-save reroll may follow an initial success or failure, before consequences, with the new result mandatory.

**Mounts and companions use the completed EX58 procedures.** A physical animal cannot obtain two turns by also being called a companion or mount. Cavalry modifies existing mount Speeds without creating modes, capacity or rider self-movement. Companion Training’s two-recipient command does not grant a second offensive companion action. Conjure Flora and Trapcasting have explicit phase, channel and shared-offense rules.

**Tinker Adept’s rest-repair exception requires the whole repair to fit.** The entire authorized repair must take no more than thirty active minutes within the owner’s genuine beneficial short rest. Completing the last thirty minutes of a long reconstruction does not qualify. Current HP, maximum HP, primary-body survival, servicing, charges and fuel remain distinct.

**Appraise retains its powerful source promise without replacing Haven settlement.** Its ten-minute examination can identify actual discoverable operative properties, subject to explicit protected-information rules. Haven’s full thirty-minute appraisal and disposition procedures remain. Reference value, buyer offer, gross proceeds and net settlement stay separate. The corrected **greater-of assay/remint assessment** remains controlling, with service fees counted once.

**Magic supplements and copies now have explicit boundaries.** Spell Focus, feat-only Eldritch Blast and feat-only Detect Thoughts remain separately identified NEW proposals outside the original registries. The finite curricula, ritual tags, copy profiles, plant modes, gadget profiles and borrowed stunts are included in full. Paid feat-copy casts are distinguished from secondary echoes and redirections; actual RP, components, cast history and source-specific no-resource restrictions remain controlling. The twelve Warrior mutation-feat pairs use one paid identity without granting another class engine or promoting their comparison class cards.
